banner.unreachable: metabox is not responding. The panel shows the last loaded data; changes cannot be applied.
banner.schema: The panel could not parse the metabox response: the daemon is newer than the panel. Screens may show incomplete data.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: Check the address in the browser — the panel has no such section.

error.description: This section failed to open because of an error in the panel itself. The config and sing-box on the router are not affected.

drift.newer: The forms know sing-box {{schema}}; the router runs a newer {{binary}}. Fields of the new version are missing from the forms: edit them in Text mode.
drift.older: The forms know sing-box {{schema}}; the router runs an older {{binary}}. A field it does not know will fail the check on apply.
